clue.text: See scold gossip all over about outfit — knitted cotton drawers?

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the outfit word goes inside the rest

explanation.definitionFit: Balbriggan is an unbleached knitted cotton fabric, named after an Irish town, used for underwear; the question mark marks drawers as an example.
